description:
Live fleet-wide counters: total devices, models, snapshots, sessions, the
running snapshot-ingest rate (snapshots/sec) and the timing of the last
insert batch. Use this for one-shot 'how big is the dataset / how fast is it
growing' questions. Unlike `fleet_summary`, no per-device aggregation is
involved — these are raw running counts from the database.
name: fleet_totals

device_count.description: Distinct devices that have ever reported a snapshot.

last_snapshot_insert_count.description: Number of snapshots in the most recent insert batch.

last_snapshot_insert_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent snapshot-batch insert.

model_count.description: Distinct resolved models (street names) across the fleet.

session_count.description: Total reboot-bounded sessions recorded across all devices.

snapshot_count.description: Total battery snapshots stored across all devices, taken from the running counter in the `globals` table.

snapshot_insert_rate.description: Exponentially-smoothed snapshot-ingest rate, in snapshots per second.

title: Fleet totals
